title: A comprehensive review of lithium-ion battery components degradation and operational considerations: a safety perspective

Idris T. Adebanjo, Juliana Eko, Anita G. Agbeyegbe, Simuck F. Yuk, Samuel V. Cowart, Enoch A. Nagelli, F. John Burpo, Jan L. Allen, Dat T. Tran, Nishma Bhattarai, Krishna Shah, Jang-Yeon Hwang, H. Hohyun Sun
This review explores degradation pathways, failure risks, and mitigation strategies in lithium-ion batteries, with focus on safety and operation in EVs, ESS, and extreme military environments.
